title: Large CSV File Export & Streaming Processing
learningObjectives: Stream million-row database exports without buffering entire datasets into memory
Manage HTTP chunked transfer encoding and browser backpressure
Sanitize spreadsheet formulas to prevent CSV Injection (Formula Injection) attacks
keyTradeoffs: Real-time streaming HTTP downloads vs asynchronous background generation with download link
Cursor-based pagination vs database streaming cursors
commonPitfalls: Loading entire million-row query results into Node.js heap memory, causing Out-Of-Memory crashes
Allowing cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` without escaping, executing code in Excel
transferPrompt: When file exports exceed 500MB, how do you offload generation to background queue workers?
